name: tulpa
author: tulpa contributors
description: tulpa: a desktop companion with voice, Live2D characters and long-term memory, for macOS and Windows 11

scripts.build: npm run build:audio:mac && npm run build:perception:mac && npm run build:pet-input:mac && npm run build:electron && npm run build:renderer
scripts.dev: npm run build:audio:mac && npm run build:perception:mac && npm run build:pet-input:mac && npm run build:electron && npm run prepare:cubism-runtime && concurrently -k "vite --host 127.0.0.1" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
scripts.test:texture-patch-gpu: npm run prepare:cubism-runtime && cross-env TEXTURE_PATCH_HARNESS=1 vite build && electron scripts/verify-texture-patch-gpu.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:cubism-framework && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json --noEmit
scripts.dist:mac:local: npm run build:runtime:mac && npm run build:plugins:mac && npm run prepare:models && npm run prepare:live2d && npm run build && node scripts/assert-packaging-idle.mjs && rimraf release dist && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac dir --arm64 --config.electronDist=node_modules/electron/dist && bash scripts/adhoc-sign-mac.sh
scripts.build:win: npm run build:native:win && npm run build:electron && npm run build:renderer
scripts.dev:win: node scripts/assert-windows-dev-runtime.mjs && npm run build:native:win && npm run build:electron && npm run prepare:cubism-runtime && concurrently -k "vite --host 127.0.0.1" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
scripts.dist:win:local: npm run build:runtime:win && npm run build:plugins:win && npm run prepare:models:win && npm run prepare:live2d:win && npm run build:win && node scripts/assert-packaging-idle.mjs && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --config packaging/electron-builder-windows.cjs --publish never
scripts.prepare:runtime:win: npm run build:runtime:win && npm run build:plugins:win

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: tulpa 使用麦克风与你进行本地语音对话。
extendInfo.NSCameraUsageDescription: tulpa 仅在本机分析可观察的面部状态，不保存或上传摄像头画面。
extendInfo.NSAudioCaptureUsageDescription: tulpa 使用系统播放音频理解正在观看或收听的内容，并排除自身语音。
